issue.title: [Security] Authenticated Non-Superusers Can Read Global Settings & Partial API Keys (GHSA-2jr7-wc87-hgcg)
issue.body:
## Security Bug Report

> **Originally reported as a private security advisory [GHSA-2jr7-wc87-hgcg](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/security/advisories/GHSA-2jr7-wc87-hgcg) on Oct 14, 2026. No response received after ~10 days, so filing publicly for visibility.**

### Summary

**Authenticated non-superusers can read global Cognee settings (Missing Authorization)**

- **Severity:** Medium
- **CWE:** CWE-200 (Exposure of Sensitive Information), CWE-862 (Missing Authorization)
- **Affected version:** cognee 1.6.4 (commit `f154b32a`)

### Description

In `cognee/api/v1/settings/routers/get_settings_router.py`, the `GET /api/v1/settings` endpoint depends on `get_authenticated_user()` but does **not** check `user.is_superuser` before returning global settings. The settings include:

- The first 10 characters of configured LLM/vector API keys (remaining characters are masked)
- The full vector database URL, which can disclose internal endpoint details or embedded connection credentials

### Impact

Disclosure of global configuration and partial secret material to **any authenticated non-superuser**. This report covers the GET/read authorization gap only.

### Precondition

The caller can authenticate to a Cognee deployment; superuser privileges are **not** required.

### Proof of Concept

Register/login as a normal non-superuser and send `GET /api/v1/settings` with that account's bearer token. The vulnerable upstream handler returns `get_settings()` without an authorization check.

### Suggested Remediation

Require `user.is_superuser` before returning settings. Return 403 for non-superuser requests.

### Reporter

@Sunil56224972

issue.title: [Bug]: Image-only chat message (no caption) is never sent and times out

labels.name: repo-a68fbf55
labels.description: Scoped for contribution. Managed by issue-readiness-check.yml.

issue.body: ### Operating System Linux ### Installation Method Docker (`ghcr.io/openhands/agent-canvas`) ### Agent Canvas Version 1.18.0 (`ghcr.io/openhands/agent-canvas:1.18.0`, build commit `9120ff6cbbe23640f0e475661e5a9c9729cdbf1f`). Also reproduced from source on `main` at `28464621d879e3e9b3ceeae9d70a71d96da6212d`. ### Bug Description If you attach an image in a conversation and send it with the text box empty, the message never reaches the agent-server. The bubble stays at "Sending..." until the pending-message watchdog marks it as failed. Sending the same image with any caption works. Cause: `useSendMessage` (`src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`) only sends when `args.content` is non-empty: ```ts if (action === "message" && args?.content) { // build text block, append image block, sendMessage(...) } return { queued: false }; ``` When the caption is empty, `content === ""`. The hook skips `conversationContext.sendMessage` but still resolves normally. `chat-interface.tsx` has already enqueued the optimistic pending message, and no error is thrown, so nothing marks it failed until `PENDING_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS` (150 s) sets it to `"Send timed out"`. The composer itself allows this submit: `custom-chat-input.tsx` enables the send button when `text.trim().length > 0 || hasAttachments`. ### Steps to Reproduce Run method: `npx @openhands/agent-canvas` (reproduced with `node bin/agent-canvas.mjs` from a source checkout at `28464621`, which is the same binary; also seen on the Docker image `1.18.0`). 1. Start Agent Canvas and configure any LLM profile. 2. Start a conversation with any text message and wait for the reply. 3. In the conversation composer, click `+` and attach a PNG. 4. Leave the text box empty and click send. 5. The image bubble shows "Sending..." and never gets acknowledged. After about 150 s it switches to the failed-send state. For comparison: repeat steps 3-4 with a caption such as `look`. That message is delivered and acknowledged right away. ### Actual Behavior - The image-only bubble stays at "Sending...". - No user `MessageEvent` shows up in `GET /api/conversations/{id}/events/search`. - The agent does not start a turn. - After 150 s the bubble switches to the failed-send state (`"Send timed out"`). - Nothing is logged to the browser console. - Embedded images go over the conversation WebSocket as base64 data URLs, so a missing upload POST is expected and is not the symptom. ### Expected Behavior An image-only message is sent to the agent-server as a user message with only an image block. It gets acknowledged like any other message and the agent starts its turn. Fully empty submissions (no text, no images) should still not send anything. ### Relevant Logs ```shell No browser console errors. No WebSocket send frame for the image-only message. ``` ### Acceptance Criteria - [ ] A screenshot/video demonstrating the bug can be replicated on main is attached to the PR. - [ ] A screenshot/video demonstrating that the bug is fixed on the PR branch is attached to the PR. - [ ] Sending one or more images with an empty caption calls `sendMessage` with `content: [{ type: "image", image_urls: [...] }]`, with all images kept. - [ ] Image-only messages do not include an empty `{ type: "text", text: "" }` block. Verified on 1.18.0 (agent-server 1.46.0) with `claude-haiku-4-5`: a user message with an empty text block plus a red PNG got the reply "I see an empty message. How can I help you today?" (the image was ignored). The same PNG sent as an image-only message got "I'm receiving just an image (a red square) with no text." A text + image control answered "Red". - [ ] Text-only messages and text + image messages are sent exactly as before (text block first, then the image block). - [ ] A message event with no text and no images is still not sent. - [ ] A WebSocket delivery failure for an image-only message still rejects, so the composer marks the pending message as errored. - [ ] Unit tests cover the cases above. ### Screenshots _Will be added in a comment: the image-only bubble stuck at "Sending..." on `main`._ ### Additional Context - **Workaround:** add any caption when sending an image. - **Scope:** `src/hooks/use-send-message.ts`, which serves the conversation-page composer and pending-message retry. Home-page launches go through `sendMessageWithAttachments` (REST) and are not affected by this guard. That path always adds a text block, even an empty one. Per the test in the acceptance criteria, that makes the model ignore an image sent without text, so it likely needs its own fix. - **Related, not duplicates:** - #16430: no progress indicator during upload. - #17359: adds `__tests__/hooks/send-message.test.tsx`. Its "ignores a message with empty content" case has no images, so a fix does not conflict with it. - **Proposed fix:** send when text or images are present and build the content array conditionally. About a 15-line change plus tests. It was verified locally: - Unit tests fail before the change and pass after. - A mock-LLM Playwright run on the full `bin/agent-canvas.mjs` stack showed image-only and text + image messages reaching the agent-server and being acknowledged in the UI. - With the unmodified hook, the image-only event never reached the backend. Happy to open a PR.

comment.body:
The linked PR ([fix(chat): deliver image-only messages over the conversation socket](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19614)) is marked as a bug fix, so the PR-description check cross-references this issue's labels — but this issue carries `ready-for-dev` without `bug` (filed via the bug template; the label appears to have been lost at triage).

Could a maintainer add the `bug` label here? That is the only red check on the PR: unit tests, builds, skill isolation, and pr-title all pass, with before/after running-Canvas evidence under `.pr/bugs/image-only-send/`.

issue.title: [Feature]: Render LaTeX math in browser Markdown

labels.name: repo-a68fbf55
labels.description: Scoped for contribution. Managed by issue-readiness-check.yml.

issue.body:
### Problem or Motivation
Agent Canvas currently displays LaTeX delimiters as plain text in chat and Markdown previews, making mathematical explanations hard to read.

### Desired Behavior
As a user, I can use standard Markdown math delimiters (`$...$` for inline and `$$...$$` for block formulas) in conversations and Markdown previews, and see them rendered in the browser.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Inline `$...$` math renders as formatted KaTeX output.
- [ ] Block `$$...$$` math renders as a centered display formula.
- [ ] Invalid LaTeX does not crash the Markdown renderer.
- [ ] A focused automated test covers inline and block math rendering.

### Alternatives Considered
Use a CDN-loaded renderer, but bundling KaTeX keeps rendering deterministic and available offline.

### Additional Context
Implemented with remark-math and rehype-katex in the shared MarkdownRenderer.

comment.body:
The implementation PR is up: [feat(markdown): render LaTeX math in chat and Markdown previews](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19621) — remark-math + rehype-katex in the shared MarkdownRenderer, bundled KaTeX (no CDN), invalid TeX renders inline as a parse-error output, focused renderer tests included, with a running-Canvas screenshot in the PR description.

One note: this issue carries `ready-for-dev` without an `enhancement` label, so the PR-description type cross-check stays red until a maintainer adds the label (same as #17398 for its PR).

@@ -271,6 +278,55 @@ def _restore_temp_fetch_state(
     return restored_repo
 
 
+def _hide_non_commit_refs(repo: Repository, hidden_refs: list[tuple[str, Oid]]) -> None:
+    """临时删除目标无法当作 commit 处理的引用，规避 libgit2 本地 fetch 报错。
+
+    libgit2 通过本地 transport 导入 fetch 结果时会枚举正式仓库的全部引用做
+    revwalk hide，引用直接指向 tree/blob 时会报 "object is not a committish"
+    使代码同步失败（如 Codex CLI 留下的 refs/codex/... checkpoint 引用）。
+    每删除一个引用就立即记录到 hidden_refs，即使后续处理失败，
+    调用方也能根据记录恢复已删除的部分。引用指向的对象本身仍留在对象库中，
+    不会丢失数据。
+    :param repo: 正式仓库
+    :param hidden_refs: 已删除引用的记录（引用名, 原目标），由调用方持有并负责恢复
+    """
+    for ref_name in list(repo.references):
+        try:
+            ref: Reference = repo.references[ref_name]
+        except Exception:
+            log.warning(f'读取引用 {ref_name} 失败 跳过隐藏', exc_info=True)
+            continue
+        if ref.type is not ReferenceType.DIRECT:
+            continue
+        # 目标直接是 commit，或是能剥到 commit 的 tag，才能参与 fetch 协商
+        target_committish: bool = False
+        try:
+            repo[ref.target].peel(Commit)
+            target_committish = True
+        except Exception:
+            # 目标对象缺失 / tree / blob / 剥不到 commit 的 tag 都无法参与协商
+            target_committish = False
+        if target_committish:
+            continue
+        try:
+            target: Oid = ref.target
+            repo.references.delete(ref_name)
+        except Exception:
+            log.warning(f'隐藏非 commit 引用 {ref_name} 失败', exc_info=True)
+            continue
+        hidden_refs.append((ref_name, target))
+        log.info(f'已临时隐藏非 commit 引用 {ref_name}')
+
+
+def _restore_hidden_refs(repo: Repository, hidden_refs: list[tuple[str, Oid]]) -> None:
+    """恢复被临时删除的引用。"""
+    for ref_name, target in hidden_refs:
+        try:
+            repo.references.create(ref_name, target, force=True)
+        except Exception:
+            log.error(f'恢复引用 {ref_name} 失败', exc_info=True)

comment.body:
部分接受：恢复失败时的日志已包含原目标 OID（`恢复引用 X 失败 原目标 <oid>`），可按日志里的 `git update-ref` 直接手动恢复。

不采纳「中止同步/重试恢复」：这些隐藏引用是第三方工具（如 Codex）的 checkpoint，不是一条龙的数据；代码同步本身已成功，为恢复第三方引用而让整次同步失败会把用户的主要任务也搭进去，且导入中途抛错会让仓库处于更复杂的中间状态。恢复失败的概率极低（同进程内 create 一个刚删掉的引用），日志 + OID 已足够兜底。

Fixed in d67581f7（日志含 OID 部分）

+            repo[ref.target].peel(Commit)
+            target_committish = True
+        except Exception:
+            # 目标对象缺失 / tree / blob / 剥不到 commit 的 tag 都无法参与协商
+            target_committish = False
+        if target_committish:
+            continue
+        try:
+            target: Oid = ref.target
+            repo.references.delete(ref_name)
+        except Exception:
+            log.warning(f'隐藏非 commit 引用 {ref_name} 失败', exc_info=True)
+            continue
+        hidden_refs.append((ref_name, target))
comment.body:
已改为先记录再删除：删除前就把 (引用名, 原目标) 写入 hidden_refs 并记日志；删除失败时回退记录，保证 hidden_refs 只含真正被删除的引用。

Fixed in d67581f7

暂不采纳持久化恢复记录：
1. 窗口极小——隐藏只发生在导入临时仓库的几秒内，且只在仓库存在非 commit 引用时生效；
2. 对象不丢——引用指向的对象始终留在对象库中，极端情况下可按日志恢复（隐藏与恢复失败的日志都含引用名与 OID）；
3. 持久化方案引入新的状态文件与其自身的失效场景（残留文件、恢复时机、与正常流程的交互），为这个罕见窗口引入这些复杂度不成比例。如果后续真的有用户撞上这个场景，再按实际反馈设计。

issue.title: fix(env): 代码同步规避非 commit 引用 下载失败纳入重试
issue.body:
## 为什么改（why）

修复代码同步 / 资源下载路径上的两个健壮性问题：用户仓库存在 Codex CLI 等工具留下的指向 tree 对象的引用时，代码同步必然失败（#2905）；环境文件下载失败时 `retry_count` 实际不生效（#2633）。

## 改动要点（what）

### 代码同步规避非 commit 引用（#2905）

**改动前**：libgit2 本地 transport 导入 fetch 结果时会枚举正式仓库全部引用做 revwalk hide，引用直接指向 tree/blob（如 Codex 的 `refs/codex/turn-diffs/checkpoints/...`）时报 `ValueError: object is not a committish`，三个代码源全部失败，用户只能手动删引用恢复。

**改动后**：导入 fetch 结果前先临时删除无法参与 fetch 协商的引用（目标不是 commit 且剥不到 commit 的直接引用），每删一个立即记录；导入结束（成功或失败）后按记录恢复引用，引用指向的对象本身不丢失。

### 下载失败纳入重试（#2633）

**改动前**：`download_and_extract_env_file()` 下载失败立即 `return False`，`retry_count` 只覆盖解压失败，与「准备重试」的设计预期不一致。

**改动后**：下载失败也进入重试循环——删除残留的不完整文件后重下，全部次数耗尽才返回 False；解压失败的既有语义（删损坏文件重下）保持不变。

## 测试情况

- Windows 11 / Python 3.11 / uv 本地验证
- 构造带 tree 引用的本地仓库 + 共享对象目录的临时仓库，复现 `object is not a committish`；应用修复后 fetch 成功、Codex 引用与对象完整恢复（见配套测试仓用例 `test_hide_non_commit_refs.py`）
- mock 下载服务验证 3 个场景：失败重试耗尽 / 首败后重试成功 / 损坏 zip 重下语义保持（见 `test_download_and_extract_env_file.py`）
- 测试仓 one_dragon 全量对比：修复前后失败数一致（均为 main 既有网络/环境依赖用例），无回归

## 是否建议 reviewer 亲自测试

不建议必须。#2905 需要仓库里存在指向 tree 的引用才能复现，测试仓用例已覆盖完整链路；#2633 行为变化只有「下载失败后重试」一处。

## 关联

- Closes #2905
- Closes #2633
- 测试仓 PR：OneDragon-Anything/zzz-od-test#94

请 @DoctorReid @ShadowLemoon review（外部贡献者无法直接设置 assignee，在此 @ 提醒）
